intent: I heard one operator claim an early dose slowed confusion and fever, and another report no change after speech and eye clarity were already gone. I witnessed neither treatment. Something clawed around my shelter vent before a broken panel cut my arm, but I am not ready to tell Rich that I may need the same medicine. What I saw outside Savannah looked coordinated, and one infected woman repeated a hymn while the others fed; I cannot decide whether that was damaged memory or something worse.
emotion: relieved, grave, candid, frightened, and explicit about uncertainty
